meta.about: The case lens's hand-labelled sentences (test/smoke/cases.ts, docs/plans/05-built/case-lens.md "Accuracy"): most from the content as the bridge reads it (from), a few written for a case the content lacks (written). Each: the word, its case and number in that sentence, the word that decides it (none: its role), the rule's page; or the readings it can't be told apart from (ambiguous). Labelled by hand from the grammar book, machine-written (Claude, 2026-10-29): wants a native speaker's check.

items.note: a list without a verb

items.sl: En kruh in dve kavi, prosim.
items.en: One loaf of bread and two coffees, please.
items.note: an order: what is wanted, or the names of it

items.sl: Medved se boji ljudi. Govori glasno, pa gre stran.
items.en: The bear is afraid of people. Talk loudly, and it goes away.

items.sl: Nejc se boji nevihte.
items.en: Nejc is afraid of the storm.

items.sl: Ne, ne bojim se nevihte.
items.en: No, I'm not afraid of the storm.

items.sl: Res? Jaz se ga ne bojim.
items.en: Really? I am not afraid of it.

items.sl: Veselim se praznika.
items.en: I'm looking forward to the holiday.

items.sl: Dobro jutro, Jan! Kolo stoji. Mi pomagaš?
items.en: Good morning, Jan! The wheel is standing still. Will you help me?

items.sl: Mi pomagate? Potrebujem pet kilogramov krompirja. Dajte ga na tehtnico.
items.en: Will you help me? I need five kilograms of potatoes. Put them on the scale.

items.sl: Seveda vam pomagam!
items.en: Of course I'll help you!

items.sl: Babici pomagam.
items.en: I help grandma.

items.sl: Nocoj ti povem zgodbo o Kekcu.
Nocoj ti povem zgodbo o Kekcu.
Hodi od vasi do vasi. Ljudje jo vzamejo v hišo in ji dajo jesti.
items.en: She walks from village to village. People take her into their house and give her something to eat.

items.sl: Hodi od vasi do vasi. Ljudje jo vzamejo v hišo in ji dajo jesti.
items.en: She walks from village to village. People take her into their house and give her something to eat.

items.sl: Ne, ni mu ga dala. Vzel ga je sam, z zvijačo.
items.en: No, she didn't give it to him. He took it himself, by a trick.

items.sl: Rekel bi mu, da ljubezni ne more nihče zapreti v stolp.
items.en: I'd tell him that nobody can lock love in a tower.

items.sl: Knjigi manjka zadnja stran.
items.en: The book is missing its last page.

items.sl: Knjigi manjka zadnja stran.
items.en: The book is missing its last page.

items.sl: Lahko dam Muriju kos kruha?
items.en: May I give Muri a piece of bread?

items.sl: Mami zapojem pesem.
items.en: I sing mum a song.

items.sl: Toneta zanima vse o konjih.
items.en: Tone is interested in everything about horses.

items.sl: Pst! Lovski blagor, Jan. Zgodaj je, rosa je še na travi. Ti je mrzlo?
items.en: Shh! Lovski blagor, Jan. It's early, the dew is still on the grass. Are you cold?

items.sl: Poskusi oba. Lipov in cvetlični. Kateri ti je bolj všeč?
items.en: Taste both. Linden and flower honey. Which one do you like more?

items.sl: Bele za oltar, rdeče za Marijo. Katere so ti bolj všeč?
items.en: The white ones for the altar, the red ones for Mary. Which do you like more?

items.sl: Rebula mi je zelo všeč.
items.en: I really like the Rebula.

items.sl: Rebula mi je zelo všeč.
items.en: I really like the Rebula.

items.sl: Jutri ti ni treba zvoniti.
items.en: Tomorrow you don't have to ring the bell.

items.sl: Dobro jutro. Tudi meni je mrzlo.
items.en: Good morning. I'm cold too.

items.sl: Koliko ti je let, Nejc?
items.en: How old are you, Nejc?

items.sl: Luka pase ovce.
items.en: Luka is grazing the sheep.

items.sl: Luka pase ovce.
items.en: Luka is grazing the sheep.

items.sl: Kje je nož?
items.en: Where is the knife?

items.sl: France je mlinar.
items.en: France is a miller.

items.sl: France je mlinar.
items.en: France is a miller.

items.sl: Voda je kot ogledalo.
items.en: The water is like a mirror.

items.sl: Vrata so odprta.
items.en: The door is open.

items.sl: Janez bere knjigo.
items.en: Janez is reading a book.

items.sl: Pijem kavo.
items.en: I'm drinking coffee.

items.sl: Lahko dobim eno kavo?
items.en: Can I have a coffee?

items.sl: Lahko dobim eno kavo?
items.en: Can I have a coffee?
items.note: agrees with kavo

items.sl: Čakam strica.
items.en: I'm waiting for my uncle.

items.sl: Imam brata in sestro.
items.en: I have a brother and a sister.

items.sl: Imam brata in sestro.
items.en: I have a brother and a sister.

items.sl: Luka išče jagnje.
items.en: Luka is looking for the lamb.

items.sl: Rad imam juho.
items.en: I like soup.

items.sl: Ja, prosim! Rad jem juho s kruhom.
items.en: Yes, please! I like eating soup with bread.

items.sl: Mi pomagate? Potrebujem pet kilogramov krompirja. Dajte ga na tehtnico.
items.en: Will you help me? I need five kilograms of potatoes. Put them on the scale.

items.sl: Ne, nimam ribe. Imam pa sir!
items.en: No, I haven't got a fish. But I've got cheese!

items.sl: Imam termin pri zdravniku.
items.en: I have an appointment at the doctor's.

items.sl: Ob osmih, ja. Pri brvi te čakam.
items.en: At eight, yes. I'll wait for you at the footbridge.

items.sl: Dobro jutro, Jan! Slišiš zvonec? Tržnica je odprta.
items.en: Good morning, Jan! Do you hear the bell? The market is open.

items.sl: Dobro jutro, Jan! Slišiš zvonec? Tržnica je odprta.
items.en: Good morning, Jan! Do you hear the bell? The market is open.

items.sl: Glasba igra do polnoči.
items.en: The music plays until midnight.

items.sl: Deklica je slepa. Ne vidi sonca.
items.en: The girl is blind. She can't see the sun.

items.sl: Dober večer, Jan. Pst! Srne so blizu. Ne govori glasno.
items.en: Good evening, Jan. Shh! The deer are close. Don't talk loudly.

items.sl: Zlato je še danes v gori. Kaj misliš, zakaj ga ni nihče odnesel?
items.en: The gold is still in the mountain today. What do you think, why has nobody carried it off?

items.sl: Medved se boji ljudi. Govori glasno, pa gre stran.
items.en: The bear is afraid of people. Talk loudly, and it goes away.

items.sl: Odlično! Po nikalnici pride rodilnik.
items.en: Excellent! After a negation comes the genitive.

items.sl: Mačka spi pri peči.
items.en: The cat is sleeping by the stove.

items.sl: Dobro jutro, Jan! Kolo stoji. Mi pomagaš?
items.en: Good morning, Jan! The wheel is standing still. Will you help me?

items.sl: Steklenica nima zamaška.
items.en: The bottle has no cork.

items.sl: Luka je na travniku, ovce so v gozdu.
items.en: Luka is in the meadow, the sheep are in the woods.

items.sl: Na travniku je ena ovca.
items.en: There is one sheep in the meadow.

items.sl: Glej, to je moja najlepša rjuha. Od moje mame.
items.en: Look, this is my most beautiful sheet. From my mother.

items.sl: Jaz sem Tine, star sem šest let. Koliko si star ti?
items.en: I am Tine, I am six years old. How old are you?

items.sl: Babica peče kruh.
items.en: Grandma bakes bread.

items.sl: Babica peče kruh.
items.en: Grandma bakes bread.

items.sl: Kruh peče babica.
items.en: Grandma bakes the bread.
items.note: the object first: babica is the subject

items.sl: Vidim mize.
items.en: I see tables.

items.sl: Mize so nove.
items.en: The tables are new.

items.sl: Brez mize ne gre.
items.en: It won't do without a table.

items.sl: Ti pojdi po poti, jaz grem k potoku.
Pojdiva iskat. Ti pojdi po poti, jaz grem k potoku.
items.en: Let us two go and look. You take the path, I will go to the stream.

items.sl: Anton, poglej!
items.en: Anton, look!

items.sl: Dober dan, učiteljica!
items.en: Hello, teacher!

items.sl: Hvala, Jan. Zdaj je stavek pravilen. Brez napake!
items.en: Thank you, Jan. Now the sentence is correct. Without a mistake!

items.sl: Hvala, Jan. Zdaj je stavek pravilen. Brez napake!
items.en: Thank you, Jan. Now the sentence is correct. Without a mistake!

items.sl: Hvala, Jan. Zdaj je stavek pravilen. Brez napake!
items.en: Thank you, Jan. Now the sentence is correct. Without a mistake!

items.sl: Zala in Tine, pridita k ognju!
items.en: Zala and Tine, come to the fire!

items.sl: Lahko pomagam, babica?
items.en: Can I help, Grandma?

items.sl: Koliko ti je let, Nejc?
items.en: How old are you, Nejc?

items.sl: Dober večer, Jan.
Tako je. Daleč od doma. Lahko noč.
items.en: That's right. Far from home. Good night.

items.sl: Na svidenje!
items.en: Goodbye!

items.sl: Dobro jutro, babica!
items.en: Good morning, grandma!

items.sl: To je hiša mojega brata.
To je hiša mojega brata.
items.note: agrees with brata

items.sl: Glej, sledi medveda!
items.en: Look, the bear's tracks!
items.note: sledi is slediti's present too; here the tracks

items.sl: Daj mi kruha.
items.en: Give me some bread.

items.sl: Kamni, les, kolo … Kaj še rabimo za mlin?
items.en: Stones, wood, a wheel … What else do we need for the mill?
items.note: a list: what is there, or what is needed

items.sl: Pa kruh? Juha brez kruha ni juha!
items.en: And bread? Soup without bread isn't soup!
items.note: And the bread? No verb to tell

items.sl: Za mizo.
items.en: To the table. / At the table.
items.note: za: for, where to, or where

items.sl: Oblake. Prihajajo iz Vipavske doline.
items.en: The clouds. They are coming from the Vipava valley.
items.note: an answer: the accusative by its form alone
